name: cosmic-button

frames.best_why: Button is fully in view with the green rim evenly lit and no cursor covering the label.

tagline: Dark rounded button inside a spinning lime-green rim.
summary: A dark rounded button wrapped in a thick lime-green border whose gradient slowly rotates. It grows slightly on hover, takes a green focus ring and keeps a plain white label.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle with a dark grey face and a thick lime-green rim, holding a line of white text. The rim shifts between pale yellow-green and deep olive as the gradient turns.
behaviour: The green rim is a rotating gradient, so the colour slides around the edge without pause. On hover the whole button grows a little and the glow around the rim thickens.
demo_content: The label reads Launch your agent on a dark rounded pill.
search_phrases: button with a spinning colored edge
call to action with a luminous frame
link button with an animated ring
sci fi button for a landing page
use_when: One primary action needs a distinctive glowing frame that still reads on dark pages.
avoid_when: The lime palette is hardcoded in its classes, so it fights a brand that uses other colours.
customise: The label comes in as children; element type, class names, link target and rel are props. The lime gradient colours are hardcoded in the classes.
weight_why: Two CSS keyframe animations on gradient spans, with no script loop.

a11y.note: Focus works and shows a ring, but the lime ring sits on a lime border and reduced motion is not honoured.

issues: The lime focus ring matches the lime border, so the focus state is easy to miss.
polish_why: Crisp layered rim and smooth rotating gradient; the lime edge dominates the dark face.
